def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    
    empty_mask = np.isclose(bins, np.max(bins)) & np.isclose(rem, np.max(bins) - item)
    tightness = rem
    penalty = np.where(rem < 0.05 * bins, 5.0, 1.0)
    
    scores[fit] = - (tightness[fit] ** 1.5) * penalty[fit]
    scores[fit & empty_mask] += 1.5
    return scores

    fit = rem >= 0

        return scores
    is_empty = (bins == bins[0]) & (rem == bins[0] - item) 
    tightness = 1.0 / (1.0 + rem)
    scores[fit] = tightness[fit]
    empty_indices = np.where(fit & (bins == np.max(bins)))[0]

        pass
    else:
        scores[fit & (rem == np.max(bins))] *= 0.5
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    initial_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    normalized_rem = rem[valid] / (initial_cap + 1e-8)
    base_score = -np.power(normalized_rem + 1.0, 4.0)
    is_empty = (bins[valid] == initial_cap)
    bonus = np.where(is_empty, 1.5, 0.0)
    scores[valid] = base_score + bonus
    return scores

    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)

    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & (rem == max_cap - item)
    
    scores[fit] = np.exp(-rem[fit]) - np.where(rem[fit] < 0.1 * bins[fit], 2.0, 0.0)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & (rem == max_cap - item)
    tightness = rem / max_cap
    scores[fit] = 1.0 - tightness[fit]
    scores[fit & is_empty] *= 0.3
    near_overflow = fit & (rem < 0.05 * max_cap) & (~is_empty)
    scores[near_overflow] *= 0.5
    return scores
